dict.string: ChillSweep looks for clutter left on your Desktop. It only reads — nothing is removed until you pick it and confirm.
ChillSweep looks for project folders and leftovers in your Documents. It only reads, and it never offers your own documents — just the parts apps rebuild by themselves.
ChillSweep looks for big, old installers and downloads you may not need any more. It only reads — nothing is removed until you pick it and confirm.
ChillSweep skips external drives, and only needs this if a folder it scans happens to live on one.
